claim: The label Generate may not communicate that the action creates an assessment from selected questions for a first-time user.

evidence.state: Ten questions selected in the question bank.
evidence.action: User must choose Generate to continue.
evidence.result: The action creates an assessment editor, but the destination object is absent from the label.

alternative_interpretations: Generate may be established product terminology or clarified by nearby text not represented in the example.
validation_needed: Observe first-time teachers and ask what they expect Generate to do before selecting it.

skeptic_review.rationale: The object-label mismatch is analytically plausible, but the example contains no observed human confusion or complete interface context.
skeptic_review.reviewed_claim: First-time teachers may not predict that Generate creates an assessment from the selected questions.
